headline: Follow package counts with AfterShip
intro: AfterShip sensors report the number of packages that are not in `Delivered` state, with attributes showing package counts by status. Setup requires an AfterShip Account, an API Key, and at least the Pro plan for Tracking API functionality.
highlights: Track deliveries across a service that supports 490+ couriers worldwide
Read a sensor value for packages not in `Delivered` state
See the number of packages per status in sensor attributes

flow.title: From API key to package counts
stages: Create or copy an API Key from the AfterShip API page
Add AfterShip in Home Assistant with the API key
Read the package count and per-status attributes
